answers.b: Atoms strive to be surrounded by eight electrons

questions.question: When does resonance (mesomerism) occur?

answers.a: When a molecule consists of two kinds of atoms
answers.b: When you can draw more than one Lewis structure for one molecule or ion, with only electrons moving
answers.c: When atoms swap places in a molecule
answers.d: When a substance occurs in two phases

questions.question: What is true for the stability of a substance with more resonance structures?

answers.c: The substance is always a gas
